subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: Should recovered or ambiguous mutating tool warnings still be delivered on normal chat turns when a final answer exists, and should read-only exec/bash commands with shell expansion be classified as mutating by default?
rationale: Current main fixes the Feishu replacement symptom but the remaining behavior is a product policy choice about diagnostics versus user-visible success, not a safe automatic cleanup.

options.title: Narrow False/Recovered Warning Fix
options.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but suppress or clear warnings when the trajectory proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

options.title: Accept Feishu Coalescing As Sufficient
options.body: Treat the current Feishu append behavior as enough once live proof shows the answer remains visible, leaving extra warning payloads as intentional diagnostics.

options.title: Broaden Exec Warning Suppression
options.body: Suppress exec warning finals after successful assistant replies across channels, accepting the risk that valid diagnostics become less visible.

recommendation.title: Narrow False/Recovered Warning Fix
recommendation.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings, but suppress or clear warnings when the trajectory proves the exec result was successful, read-only, or recovered before the final reply.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current Feishu coalescing fix and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this is now a Feishu presentation issue or a broader warning-policy change.
